{{Quote|The songs of eons past tell of battles between Mandalore the Great, and an order of sorcerers called Jedi that fought with such powers.|The Armorer|audio=ArmorerWars-TMS01CH08.flac|<ref name="Chapter 8" />}}
'''Mandalore the Great''' was a [[Mandalorian]] individual who first<ref name="Chapter 18" /> held the title of [[Mandalore (title)|Mand'alor]].<ref name="Chapter 8" /> According to ancient folklore, Mandalore the Great defeated a [[mythosaur]] at its lair in the [[Mines of Mandalore]] and then tamed the mythical beast.<ref name="Chapter 18">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore}}</ref> Mandalore the Great was also known for leading a series of [[Mandalorian-Jedi War|conflicts]] against the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="Chapter 8" /> The legends of Mandalore the Great riding the mythosaur caused the mythosaur skull emblem to become one of the traditional symbols of Mandalorian iconography. Prior to the [[Great Purge of Mandalore]], a plaque was erected near the entrance to the [[Living Waters|living waters]] of Mandalore below a [[Civic Center|civic center]] in the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Sundari]] in honor of Mandalore the Great and his battle against a mythosaur.<ref name="Chapter 18" /> By the [[New Republic Era|time]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[Jedi]]<ref name="Chapter 8" /> and the mythosaur<ref name="Return of the Mandalorian">{{BOBF|Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian}}</ref> had become a myth, though the battles between Mandalore the Great and the Jedi were known to some Mandalorians through ancient [[Music|songs]].<ref name="Chapter 8" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|8}}</ref> a [[The Armorer|Mandalorian armorer]] relayed the tales of Mandalore the Great to [[Din Djarin]] upon discovering that the [[Din Grogu|child]] accompanying him was a [[Force-sensitive]] individual.<ref name="Chapter 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalore the Great was first mentioned in [[Chapter 8: Redemption|Chapter 8]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 8" /> which aired on [[December 27]], 2019.<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref> Mandalore the Great's title is similar to that of [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], who led the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="History of the Mandalorians">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref>
